overview_description.description: Gooseworks develops AI coworkers and supporting tools focused on go-to-market, sales, and marketing workflows. The core Goose product functions as a digital coworker with its own filesystem, mailbox, memories, and accounts, accessible via Slack, email, messaging apps, and a web interface. It is used to manage ad campaigns, generate creatives, monitor competitors, run SEO pipelines, and handle outbound and reporting tasks. Gooseworks also offers a CLI that equips AI agents such as Claude with more than one hundred predefined skills and data APIs for prospecting, research, and content production. In addition, the company operates Goose Ads, a creative service that uses AI and human review to produce short-form video ad variants for brands. These offerings target founders, growth teams, and marketing organizations seeking to systematize and scale their digital GTM operations using AI-driven infrastructure.
